question: Commission reply to petition No 0753/2026 on railway safety in Spain

In its reply of 4 August 2026 to petition No 0753/2026, which pointed out possible shortcomings in maintenance and safety and the investigation into the Adamuz and Genlida railway accidents in January 2026, the Commission noted that Spain’s Railway Accident Investigation Commission (CIAF) had requested technical assistance from the European Railway Agency (ERA).

ERA is advising CIAF on investigation methods and will provide an evaluation of the procedures followed in the investigation. It will also issue an opinion in accordance with the Railway Safety Directive, the conclusions of which will be set out in an internal report available to CIAF, ERA and the European Commission. In view of the above: 1.
On what date did CIAF request this assistance and what specific technical assistance has ERA provided so far?
If the resulting report is internal in nature, how will the European Parliament, which is responsible for democratic scrutiny in the EU, be made aware of the conclusions of the opinion?

In the wake of another fatal accident on 28 October 2026 on the same section of railway, does the Commission believe that the national authorities are satisfactorily implementing the EU legal framework on railway safety?
